021/**
022 * Enterprise Integration Patterns using StreamConverter.
023 *
024 * <p>This demonstrates common enterprise integration scenarios: - Message Translation -
025 * Content-Based Router - Scatter-Gather - Request-Reply - Message Filter - Dead Letter Queue
026 * handling
027 */
028public class EnterpriseIntegrationPatterns {
029
030  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EnterpriseIntegrationPatterns.class);
031  private static final ExecutorService executorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(20);
032
033  /**
034   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。エンタープライズ統合パターンの例を実行します。
035   *
036   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
037   */
038  public static void main(String[] args) {
039    logger.info("🏢 Enterprise Integration Patterns");
040    logger.info("===================================\n");
041
042    try {
043      // Pattern 1: Message Translation
044      demonstrateMessageTranslation();
045
046      // Pattern 2: Content-Based Router
047      demonstrateContentBasedRouter();
048
049      // Pattern 3: Scatter-Gather
050      demonstrateScatterGather();
051
052      // Pattern 4: Request-Reply with timeout
053      demonstrateRequestReply();
054
055      // Pattern 5: Message Filter
056      demonstrateMessageFilter();
057
058      // Pattern 6: Dead Letter Queue
059      demonstrateDeadLetterQueue();
060
061    } catch (Exception e) {
062      logger.error("Enterprise pattern demonstration failed: " + e.getMessage());
063      e.printStackTrace();
064    } finally {
065      shutdownExecutor();
066    }
067  }
068
069  /** Pattern 1: Message Translation Transforms message format from one system to another */
070  private static void demonstrateMessageTranslation() throws IOException {
071    logger.info("🔄 Message Translation Pattern");
072    logger.info("===============================");
073
074    // Input: Legacy system XML format
075    String legacyXml =
076        """
077        <?xml version="1.0"?>
078        <LegacyOrder>
079          <OrderID>ORD001</OrderID>
080          <Customer>
081            <CustID>CUST123</CustID>
082            <Name>John Doe</Name>
083            <Email>john@example.com</Email>
084          </Customer>
085          <Items>
086            <Item>
087              <SKU>SKU001</SKU>
088              <Quantity>2</Quantity>
089              <Price>29.99</Price>
090            </Item>
091          </Items>
092        </LegacyOrder>
093        """;
094
095    logger.info("📨 Legacy XML Input:");
096    logger.info(legacyXml);
097
098    // Translation pipeline: Extract key fields and transform
099    IStreamCommand[] translationPipeline = {
100      XmlNavigateCommand.create(new XPath("LegacyOrder/OrderID"), new PassThroughRule()),
101      new SampleStreamCommand("order-translator"),
102      new SampleStreamCommand("format-modernizer")
103    };
104
105    logger.info("\n🔄 Translating to modern format...");
106    executePattern(legacyXml, translationPipeline, "Message Translation");
107
108    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
109  }
110
111  /** Pattern 2: Content-Based Router Routes messages based on content */
112  private static void demonstrateContentBasedRouter() throws IOException {
113    logger.info("🛤️ Content-Based Router Pattern");
114    logger.info("=================================");
115
116    // Different message types
117    String[] messages = {
118      """
119        <?xml version="1.0"?>
120        <Message>
121          <Type>ORDER</Type>
122          <Priority>HIGH</Priority>
123          <Data>Order processing required</Data>
124        </Message>
125        """,
126      """
127        <?xml version="1.0"?>
128        <Message>
129          <Type>NOTIFICATION</Type>
130          <Priority>LOW</Priority>
131          <Data>User notification</Data>
132        </Message>
133        """,
134      """
135        <?xml version="1.0"?>
136        <Message>
137          <Type>ALERT</Type>
138          <Priority>CRITICAL</Priority>
139          <Data>System alert</Data>
140        </Message>
141        """
142    };
143
144    logger.info("📬 Processing different message types...");
145
146    for (int i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) {
147      logger.info("\n📨 Message " + (i + 1) + ":");
148
149      // Route based on message type
150      IStreamCommand[] routingPipeline = {
151        XmlNavigateCommand.create(new XPath("Message/Type"), new PassThroughRule()),
152        new SampleStreamCommand("content-router-" + (i + 1))
153      };
154
155      executePattern(messages[i], routingPipeline, "Content-Based Routing");
156    }
157
158    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
159  }
160
161  /** Pattern 3: Scatter-Gather Distributes request to multiple services and aggregates responses */
162  private static void demonstrateScatterGather() throws IOException {
163    logger.info("📡 Scatter-Gather Pattern");
164    logger.info("==========================");
165
166    String requestXml =
167        """
168        <?xml version="1.0"?>
169        <PriceRequest>
170          <ProductID>PROD123</ProductID>
171          <Quantity>100</Quantity>
172          <RequestID>REQ001</RequestID>
173        </PriceRequest>
174        """;
175
176    logger.info("📨 Price Request:");
177    logger.info(requestXml);
178
179    logger.info("\n🚀 Scattering request to multiple suppliers...");
180
181    // Simulate multiple supplier endpoints
182    String[] suppliers = {"supplier-a", "supplier-b", "supplier-c"};
183    CompletableFuture<String>[] futures = new CompletableFuture[suppliers.length];
184
185    for (int i = 0; i < suppliers.length; i++) {
186      final String supplier = suppliers[i];
187      final int supplierIndex = i;
188
189      futures[i] =
190          CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(
191              () -> {
192                try {
193                  // Simulate processing with each supplier
194                  IStreamCommand[] supplierPipeline = {
195                    XmlNavigateCommand.create(
196                        new XPath("PriceRequest/ProductID"), new PassThroughRule()),
197                    new SampleStreamCommand("supplier-" + supplier),
198                    new SampleStreamCommand("price-calculator-" + supplierIndex)
199                  };
200
201                  return processSupplierRequest(requestXml, supplierPipeline, supplier);
202                } catch (Exception e) {
203                  return "Error from " + supplier + ": " + e.getMessage();
204                }
205              },
206              executorService);
207    }
208
209    // Gather results
210    logger.info("\n📥 Gathering responses...");
211    for (int i = 0; i < futures.length; i++) {
212      String result = futures[i].join();
213      logger.info("✅ " + suppliers[i] + " response: " + result.trim());
214    }
215
216    logger.info("\n🎯 Aggregating best price...");
217    logger.info("✅ Best price selected and response prepared");
218
219    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
220  }

222  /** Pattern 4: Request-Reply with timeout Handles request-reply with timeout management */
223  private static void demonstrateRequestReply() throws IOException {
224    logger.info("🔄 Request-Reply Pattern");
225    logger.info("=========================");
226
227    String requestXml =
228        """
229        <?xml version="1.0"?>
230        <ServiceRequest>
231          <RequestID>REQ002</RequestID>
232          <Service>UserValidation</Service>
233          <UserID>USR456</UserID>
234        </ServiceRequest>
235        """;
236
237    logger.info("📨 Service Request:");
238    logger.info(requestXml);
239
240    logger.info("\n⏱️ Processing with timeout...");
241
242    // Simulate request processing with timeout
243    CompletableFuture<String> requestFuture =
244        CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(
245            () -> {
246              try {
247                // Simulate processing delay
248                Thread.sleep(1000);
249
250                IStreamCommand[] requestPipeline = {
251                  XmlNavigateCommand.create(
252                      new XPath("ServiceRequest/UserID"), new PassThroughRule()),
253                  new SampleStreamCommand("user-validator"),
254                  new SampleStreamCommand("response-formatter")
255                };
256
257                return processWithTimeout(requestXml, requestPipeline);
258              } catch (Exception e) {
259                return "Request processing error: " + e.getMessage();
260              }
261            },
262            executorService);
263
264    try {
265      // Wait for result with timeout
266      String result = requestFuture.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
267      logger.info("✅ Request processed successfully:");
268      logger.info(result);
269    } catch (Exception e) {
270      logger.info("⏰ Request timeout or error: " + e.getMessage());
271      // Implement timeout handling
272      logger.info("🔄 Implementing timeout recovery...");
273    }
274
275    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
276  }

278  /** Pattern 5: Message Filter Filters messages based on criteria */
279  private static void demonstrateMessageFilter() throws IOException {
280    logger.info("🔍 Message Filter Pattern");
281    logger.info("==========================");
282
283    String[] messages = {
284      """
285        <?xml version="1.0"?>
286        <LogEntry>
287          <Level>ERROR</Level>
288          <Message>Database connection failed</Message>
289          <Timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</Timestamp>
290        </LogEntry>
291        """,
292      """
293        <?xml version="1.0"?>
294        <LogEntry>
295          <Level>INFO</Level>
296          <Message>User login successful</Message>
297          <Timestamp>2023-07-15T10:31:00Z</Timestamp>
298        </LogEntry>
299        """,
300      """
301        <?xml version="1.0"?>
302        <LogEntry>
303          <Level>ERROR</Level>
304          <Message>Payment processing failed</Message>
305          <Timestamp>2023-07-15T10:32:00Z</Timestamp>
306        </LogEntry>
307        """
308    };
309
310    logger.info("📋 Filtering ERROR level messages...");
311
312    for (int i = 0; i < messages.length; i++) {
313      // Check if message should be filtered
314      String level = extractLevel(messages[i]);
315
316      if ("ERROR".equals(level)) {
317        logger.info("\n🚨 Processing ERROR message " + (i + 1) + ":");
318
319        IStreamCommand[] filterPipeline = {
320          XmlNavigateCommand.create(new XPath("LogEntry/Message"), new PassThroughRule()),
321          new SampleStreamCommand("error-processor"),
322          new SampleStreamCommand("alert-sender")
323        };
324
325        executePattern(messages[i], filterPipeline, "Error Processing");
326      } else {
327        logger.info("\n✅ Filtered out " + level + " message " + (i + 1));
328      }
329    }
330
331    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
332  }

334  /** Pattern 6: Dead Letter Queue Handles failed messages */
335  private static void demonstrateDeadLetterQueue() throws IOException {
336    logger.info("💀 Dead Letter Queue Pattern");
337    logger.info("=============================");
338
339    String[] problematicMessages = {
340      """
341        <?xml version="1.0"?>
342        <BadMessage>
343          <InvalidField>This will cause processing error</InvalidField>
344          <!-- Missing required fields -->
345        </BadMessage>
346        """,
347      """
348        <?xml version="1.0"?>
349        <Message>
350          <Type>INVALID_TYPE</Type>
351          <Data>Unknown message type</Data>
352        </Message>
353        """,
354      """
355        This is not even valid XML!
356        """
357    };
358
359    logger.info("⚠️ Processing problematic messages...");
360
361    for (int i = 0; i < problematicMessages.length; i++) {
362      logger.info("\n📨 Message " + (i + 1) + ":");
363
364      try {
365        IStreamCommand[] processingPipeline = {
366          XmlNavigateCommand.create(new XPath("Message/Type"), new PassThroughRule()),
367          new SampleStreamCommand("message-processor")
368        };
369
370        executePattern(problematicMessages[i], processingPipeline, "Normal Processing");
371        logger.info("✅ Message processed successfully");
372
373      } catch (Exception e) {
374        logger.info("❌ Processing failed: " + e.getMessage());
375        logger.info("📤 Sending to Dead Letter Queue...");
376
377        // Send to Dead Letter Queue
378        sendToDeadLetterQueue(problematicMessages[i], e.getMessage());
379      }
380    }
381
382    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
383  }
384
385  /** Helper method to execute a pattern */
386  private static void executePattern(String inputXml, IStreamCommand[] pipeline, String patternName)
387      throws IOException {
388    try (InputStream inputStream =
389            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputXml.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
390        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
391
392      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(pipeline);
393      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
394
395      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
396      logger.info("✅ " + patternName + " result:");
397      logger.info(result.trim());
398    }
399  }
400

403      String requestXml, IStreamCommand[] pipeline, String supplier) throws IOException {
404    try (InputStream inputStream =
405            new ByteArrayInputStream(requestXml.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
406        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {

415  /** Helper method to process with timeout */
416  private static String processWithTimeout(String requestXml, IStreamCommand[] pipeline)
417      throws IOException {
418    try (InputStream inputStream =
419            new ByteArrayInputStream(requestXml.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
420        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
421
422      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(pipeline);
423      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
424
425      return outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
426    }
427  }
428
429  /** Helper method to extract level from log message */
430  private static String extractLevel(String logXml) {
431    // Simple extraction for demo purposes
432    if (logXml.contains("<Level>ERROR</Level>")) {
433      return "ERROR";
434    } else if (logXml.contains("<Level>INFO</Level>")) {
435      return "INFO";
436    }
437    return "UNKNOWN";
438  }
439
440  /** Helper method to send message to Dead Letter Queue */
441  private static void sendToDeadLetterQueue(String message, String error) {
442    logger.info("💀 Dead Letter Queue Entry:");
443    logger.info("   Message: " + message.substring(0, Math.min(100, message.length())) + "...");
444    logger.info("   Error: " + error);
445    logger.info("   Timestamp: " + java.time.Instant.now());
446    logger.info("   Status: QUEUED_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW");
447  }
448
449  /** Helper method to shutdown executor */
450  private static void shutdownExecutor() {
451    executorService.shutdown();
452    try {
453      if (!executorService.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
454        executorService.shutdownNow();
455      }
456    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
457      executorService.shutdownNow();
458    }
459  }
